key_path: Fastest: connect hosted MCP https://mcp.mapbox.com/mcp (or DevKit https://mcp-devkit.mapbox.com/mcp) -> browser OAuth page offers 'Start without a card' sign-up
Console shows default public token (pk.*) / trial token - usable immediately
Optional: Tokens API (needs a token with tokens:write) or local DevKit create_token_tool to mint scoped/temporary tokens
human_gates: credit_card_required (only to lift demo-access caps / unlock some products)

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - mcp.mapbox.com publishes RFC 9728 + RFC 8414 metadata with registration_endpoint https://api.mapbox.com/oauth/register, PKCE S256; signup can happen inside the MCP OAuth flow
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes - Tokens API create/temporary tokens (tokens:write); DevKit create_token_tool (local only, 1h temp tokens)
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes - public/secret scopes, URL restrictions, temporary tokens
agent_native_auth.test_credentials_sandbox: no sandbox; demo access with usage caps acts as a free trial
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes - card-free demo access (e.g. 5,000 web map loads, 10,000 Directions/Geocoding) and larger free tiers once a card is added

mcp.product_mcp_remote: https://mcp.mapbox.com/mcp (geospatial tools: geocoding, directions, isochrones, static maps) and https://mcp-devkit.mapbox.com/mcp (styles, tokens, docs), Streamable HTTP, OAuth
mcp.one_click: config snippets for Claude/Cursor/VS Code (mcp-remote bridge); Agent Skills `npx skills add mapbox/mapbox-agent-skills`

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://docs.mapbox.com/llms.txt (root index linking per-product llms.txt e.g. /mapbox-gl-js/llms.txt, /accounts/llms.txt)
docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - API reference and guides at .md (e.g. /api/maps/styles.md, /accounts/guides/signup.md)
docs_for_agents.openapi: not found as a published spec

time_to_first_call_notes: One OAuth flow both creates the account (card-free) and connects the MCP; human only verifies email.
agent_friendliness_justification: Sign-up embedded in the hosted MCP OAuth flow, card-free demo access, DCR and token-minting API; lacks a CLI and OpenAPI spec, and token creation tool is disabled on the hosted endpoint.
best_practice: Account creation inside the MCP OAuth screen ('Start without a card') so 'connect the MCP' and 'sign up' are the same step.
biggest_gap: No CLI/device login and hosted DevKit cannot mint tokens, so app code still needs a human to copy a token from the console.
